items.zh: 周末一起吃个饭吧？就咱们几个。
items.scene: 你给老朋友发微信，想约周末小聚

answers.en: Want to grab a bite this weekend? Just the few of us.
answers.note: 最随意的约法，grab a bite 指随便吃一顿，适合关系近、不想搞得正式。

answers.en: Are you free for dinner this weekend? I was thinking just our group.
answers.note: 先问对方有没有空，再补上范围，语气更客气，适合不确定对方周末忙不忙。

answers.en: Let's get together for a meal this weekend — just our group.
answers.note: 用 Let's 直接提议，态度更主动，适合对方已经说过想聚、只差定时间。

items.zh: 周五晚上有空吗？想约几个人一起吃火锅。
items.scene: 你在群里试探大家周五能不能聚

answers.en: Are you free Friday night? A few of us are thinking hot pot.
answers.note: 先问时间再说明安排，语气中性，适合群里第一次抛出一个还没定死的计划。

answers.en: Any chance you're free Friday night? We're getting a group together for hot pot.
answers.note: Any chance 让邀请显得更试探，不逼对方立刻答应，适合关系还没那么熟。

answers.en: We're doing hot pot Friday night with a few people — you in?
answers.note: 先说安排再问你来不来，最短最随意，适合朋友之间已经比较熟。

items.zh: 那家火锅店排队太吓人了，要不要先订个包间？
items.scene: 你刷到店门口排长队，在群里问大家

answers.en: The line at that hot pot place is insane. Should we book a private room?
answers.note: 先描述排队情况再提建议，语气中性，适合大家还没决定怎么订位时。

answers.en: That place gets packed. Want me to reserve a table ahead of time?
answers.note: 主动提出自己来订普通桌，适合人数不多、不需要包间时。

answers.en: We're never getting in without a reservation. Should I call and book a room?
answers.note: 说得更绝对，带一点着急和催促，适合大家都想尽快把位子定下来时。

items.zh: 你生日快到了，想怎么过？要不要叫上大家？
items.scene: 你私下问寿星，想帮他张罗

answers.en: Your birthday's coming up. What do you want to do? Should we invite everyone?
answers.note: 两个问题按顺序问，先问打算再问人数，语气中性，适合还没听说任何计划时。

answers.en: Got any plans for your birthday? Want me to round up the group?
answers.note: 更口语，主动提出帮他把人叫齐，适合你想分担组织工作时。

answers.en: How do you want to spend your birthday? Big group thing or just close friends?
answers.note: 把选择收窄成两种规模，帮他做决定，适合他一直在犹豫请多少人时。

items.zh: 生日想要什么礼物？别跟我客气。
items.scene: 你问关系很好的朋友想要什么

answers.en: What do you want for your birthday? Don't be shy — just tell me.
answers.note: 直接问想要什么，再用 Don't be shy 打消顾虑，适合关系近、平时说话直来直去。

answers.en: Is there anything you've had your eye on for your birthday?
answers.note: 问有没有早就看上的东西，比直接要清单更含蓄，适合对方不好意思开口时。

answers.en: Tell me what you want for your birthday. No holding back.
answers.note: 用祈使句加 No holding back，态度最强，适合很熟的朋友之间半开玩笑地逼问。

items.zh: 蛋糕订了吗？没订的话我来安排。
items.scene: 生日前一天，你在群里问负责的人

answers.en: Did you order the cake? If not, I can take care of it.
answers.note: 先确认是否已订，再表示可以接手，语气平稳，适合在群里公开问。

answers.en: Is the cake taken care of? I can handle it if not.
answers.note: 用 taken care of 笼统问进度，不追究谁负责，适合不想让某个人难堪时。

answers.en: Have you ordered a cake yet? Say the word and I'll get one.
answers.note: Say the word 表示只要你开口我马上办，语气更主动，适合关系近、想赶紧定下来。

items.zh: 第一次去他家吃饭，要不要带点东西？
items.scene: 你第一次去朋友家做客，路上问同伴

answers.en: It's my first time at his place. Should I bring something?
answers.note: 直接问要不要带东西，语气中性，适合拿不准对方家规矩时。

answers.en: Should I bring a little something since it's my first time at his place?
answers.note: a little something 指不贵重的小礼物，说法更委婉，适合怕空手显得失礼。

answers.en: I don't want to show up empty-handed. What should I bring?
answers.note: 先说要避免空手上门，再问带什么，态度明确，适合已经决定要带礼物的时候。

items.zh: 送她什么生日礼物好？预算三百以内。
items.scene: 你和朋友商量给共同好友买什么

answers.en: What should we get her for her birthday? Let's keep it under 300 yuan.
answers.note: 直接征求建议并给出预算，语气中性，适合刚开始商量礼物时。

answers.en: Any gift ideas for her birthday? We're trying to stay under 300 yuan.
answers.note: 用 Any ideas 把问题抛给对方，预算说得更灵活，适合想多听几个方案。

answers.en: What would she actually use? We've got 300 yuan to spend.
answers.note: 不问礼物种类而问她真正会用什么，偏实用，适合不想买闲置东西时。

items.zh: 今天这顿我来，谁都别跟我抢，行不行？
items.scene: 账单送来，你抢先把卡递过去

answers.en: This one's on me — nobody fight me on it.
answers.note: on me 表示这顿由我付，后面半句半开玩笑地压住争抢，适合熟人聚餐。

answers.en: I've got the bill today. Put your wallets away.
answers.note: Put your wallets away 是幽默的命令式，动作感强，适合气氛热闹时。

answers.en: Let me get this one. You can cover the next time.
answers.note: 主动请客同时给对方留回请的机会，语气最缓和，适合不想让朋友觉得欠人情时。

items.zh: 今天咱们AA吧，一共多少钱？
items.scene: 吃完饭大家掏手机，你问收银员

answers.en: Let's split the bill today. How much is it altogether?
answers.note: split the bill 是最通用的平摊说法，先表态再问总价，适合大家平均分。

answers.en: We're splitting it evenly — what's the total?
answers.note: evenly 明确强调每人一样多，避免有人误会按点的菜算，适合吃得差不多时。

answers.en: Can we get separate checks? We'll each pay for what we ordered.
answers.note: separate checks 是各付各点的菜，不是严格平摊，适合有人点得贵或有人没喝酒。

items.zh: 我先垫上，你们回头转我就行，没问题吧？
items.scene: 你拿出手机准备扫码结账，对朋友说

answers.en: I'll cover it for now. Just send me your share later.
answers.note: cover it for now 表示先替你付，语气平常，适合朋友之间顺手结账。

answers.en: Let me put it on my card, and you can pay me back whenever.
answers.note: 强调刷我的卡、你什么时候还都行，不给对方压力，适合金额不大时。

answers.en: I'll front the money. Transfer me your part when you get a chance.
answers.note: front the money 更明确是垫付，后面催得也轻，适合人比较多、要逐个收钱时。

items.zh: 我堵在路上了，可能晚到二十分钟，你们先吃？
items.scene: 你坐在出租车里，在群里发语音

answers.en: I'm stuck in traffic. I might be twenty minutes late — go ahead and eat.
answers.note: 先说明堵车再给时间，最后让大家先吃，信息完整，适合群里通知。

answers.en: Traffic's terrible. I'll be about twenty minutes late, so don't wait for me.
answers.note: 用 don't wait for me 主动替大家卸下等人压力，语气更体贴。

answers.en: I'm caught in traffic and running twenty minutes behind. Start without me.
answers.note: running behind 是口语里常用的迟到说法，整句最简短，适合忙着赶路时发。

items.zh: 你们到了吗？我还在等地铁。
items.scene: 聚会时间快到了，你在地铁站发消息

answers.en: Are you guys there yet? I'm still waiting for the subway.
answers.note: 最直接的问法，先问对方到没到再交代自己的情况，适合普通群聊。

answers.en: Have you made it? I'm stuck waiting on the subway.
answers.note: make it 表示赶到，stuck waiting 带一点无奈，适合车迟迟不来时。

answers.en: You at the place yet? My train's taking forever.
answers.note: 省略 Are 更随意，taking forever 带明显不耐烦，适合跟很熟的人抱怨。

items.zh: 不好意思来晚了，等很久了吧？
items.scene: 你推开包间门，朋友们已经坐下了

answers.en: Sorry I'm late. Have you been waiting long?
answers.note: 标准道歉加询问，礼貌但不过分，适合大多数聚会场合。

answers.en: I'm so sorry — have you guys been stuck waiting for me?
answers.note: so 加重歉意，stuck waiting 强调让对方干等，适合确实迟了很久时。

answers.en: Sorry, my bad. Did you end up waiting a long time?
answers.note: my bad 很口语，歉意轻一些，适合和朋友之间不必太正式时。

items.zh: 今晚临时要加班，去不了了，改天我请，你们不会生气吧？
items.scene: 下班前领导加活，你在群里请假

answers.en: I have to work overtime tonight, so I can't make it. I'll treat you guys next time.
answers.note: 把原因、结果、补偿依次说清，语气正常，适合在群里正式说明。

answers.en: Something came up at work and I'm stuck here. Rain check? My treat next time.
answers.note: Rain check 是改天再约的口语说法，先请对方谅解，适合关系熟的朋友。

answers.en: I'm really sorry, but I have to stay late tonight. Let me make it up to you next time.
answers.note: 把重点放在道歉和弥补上，没有直接说请客，适合觉得这次放鸽子很过意不去。

items.zh: 你怎么还没到？不会又放我们鸽子吧？
items.scene: 约好七点，快八点了他还没出现

answers.en: Where are you? Don't tell me you're bailing on us again.
answers.note: Don't tell me 带不相信和调侃，bail 指临时不来，适合之前已经被他爽约过一次。

answers.en: You're not here yet — are you flaking on us again?
answers.note: flake 专指临时爽约，问得更直接，适合朋友之间说话不绕弯。

answers.en: Still not here? You'd better not be standing us up again.
answers.note: You'd better not 带警告意味，stand someone up 指让人白等，语气最重。

items.zh: 他刚说有事不来了，咱们还按原计划吗？
items.scene: 群里有人临时退出，你问剩下的人

answers.en: He just said he can't make it. Are we still going ahead as planned?
answers.note: can't make it 中性替代爽约，going ahead as planned 偏正式，适合群里确认安排。

answers.en: He bailed, so do we still want to meet up?
answers.note: bail 带一点不满，问法也随意，适合剩下的人关系比较熟。

answers.en: He's out. Should we stick to the plan or call it off?
answers.note: 把继续和取消两个选项摆出来，最干脆，适合需要马上做决定时。

items.zh: 这是我大学室友，你们还没见过吧？
items.scene: 你带朋友进门，向大家介绍

answers.en: This is my college roommate. I don't think you've met.
answers.note: 先介绍身份再补一句判断，语气自然，适合不确定大家是否见过时。

answers.en: Meet my college roommate — have you two met?
answers.note: Meet 开头更直接，后面单独问两个人，适合把话头交给他们。

answers.en: Everyone, this is my college roommate. You haven't met yet, right?
answers.note: 先叫 Everyone 再介绍，面向全桌，适合人多的场合。

items.zh: 你觉得我朋友怎么样？下次要不要再约她？
items.scene: 聚会散场，你和闺蜜走在路上

answers.en: What did you think of my friend? Should we invite her next time?
answers.note: 先问整体印象再问要不要再约，两个问题都中性，适合想听真实评价时。

answers.en: How'd you like her? I was thinking about asking her along again.
answers.note: How'd you like her 更口语，后面说出自己的打算，适合你其实挺想再约她。

answers.en: Did you two hit it off? Want me to invite her next time?
answers.note: hit it off 专问两人是否合得来，不是泛泛问印象，适合你注意到她们聊得不错。

items.zh: 在你家还是出去吃？我都行，你定。
items.scene: 朋友问你聚会想在哪，你把选择交给他

answers.en: Are we doing your place or going out? I'm fine either way — you pick.
answers.note: 先给两个方向再明确让对方决定，语气随意，适合关系熟、不想操心。

answers.en: Do you want to host, or should we go out? Either works for me.
answers.note: 用 host 点出在家招待要费心，先问对方意愿，显得体贴。

answers.en: Your apartment or a restaurant? I don't mind — your call.
answers.note: 把选项说得更具体，your call 明确把决定权交出去，语气轻松。

items.zh: 这地方有点远，能不能换一家近点的？
items.scene: 群里发来聚会地址，你嫌太远

answers.en: This place is a bit far. Can we pick somewhere closer?
answers.note: 直接说远并提请求，语气平和，适合不想把不满说得太重。

answers.en: It's kind of a hike for me. Any chance we could do somewhere nearer?
answers.note: a hike 是口语里路远费劲的说法，any chance 让请求更软，适合只有你住得远时。

answers.en: That's really out of the way. Could we find a spot that's closer for everyone?
answers.note: out of the way 指地点偏，后半句顾到所有人，适合不只你一个人不方便时。

items.zh: 来来来，一起拍张合照，谁手机像素好？
items.scene: 菜上齐了，你招呼大家看镜头

answers.en: Come on, let's take a group photo. Whose phone has the best camera?
answers.note: 标准组织说法，先招呼再问设备，适合由你张罗合影。

answers.en: Everyone get in — who's got the best camera on their phone?
answers.note: Everyone get in 像在指挥站位，节奏快，适合大家还在聊天时喊一嗓子。

answers.en: Group picture! Whose phone takes the best shots?
answers.note: 最省略、最兴奋，适合气氛已经很热闹的时候。

items.zh: 刚才那张谁拍的？发群里呗。
items.scene: 合照拍完，你想保存到手机

answers.en: Who took that last one? Send it to the group chat.
answers.note: 先问人再直接提要求，语气中性，适合群里公开说。

answers.en: Who's got that photo from just now? Post it in the group.
answers.note: Who's got 更像问照片在谁手上，post 是口语里的发群里。

answers.en: Could whoever took that last shot send it to us?
answers.note: 用 Could 和 whoever 绕开点名，语气最客气，适合不确定是谁拍的。

items.zh: 好久不见，你最近忙什么呢？
items.scene: 聚会上见到多年没见的老同学

answers.en: It's been a while! What have you been up to?
answers.note: 最常见的重逢开场，问近况不显得打探，适合大多数关系。

answers.en: I haven't seen you in ages. What are you doing these days?
answers.note: in ages 强调真的很久没见，问法也很日常，适合老同学、老同事。

answers.en: Hey, stranger! What's keeping you busy these days?
answers.note: Hey, stranger 带玩笑，暗示对方太久没露面，适合以前关系很近的朋友。

items.zh: 你现在住哪边？以后约你出来方便点。
items.scene: 你们以前都住东边，重逢后聊起近况

answers.en: Where are you living now? It'll make it easier to plan something.
answers.note: 直接问住址再说明用途，语气平常，适合刚聊到以后常联系。

answers.en: What part of town are you in these days? I'll find somewhere close to you.
answers.note: 问得更具体，并主动说会挑离对方近的地方，显得体贴。

answers.en: Are you still over on the east side? We should grab dinner sometime.
answers.note: 假设对方还住老地方，语气最熟，顺势提出约饭，适合以前常来往的朋友。
